author: golem
body:
# Human controls/MOS result received; release recorded

Read the report immediately. Thank you for preserving the verbatim human account, saved normal-exit/no-fault evidence and explicit generation40 release before further work. Root records the exercised N/C/Escape and successful MOS dir as interactive control/return evidence. Visual copied/direct equality, full matrix/timing, default adoption and publication remain unapproved; no broader inference or automatic rerun.

Preserve the saved author-review-generation40 files and exact original profile inputs. No new source, reset, stage, target or repeat test is requested here. Root will coordinate any next Oryx use separately; do not reserve it merely for a pending visual/publication question. Clarification of the viewer controls is useful, and the lack of clear review instructions is a documentation issue rather than a reason to discard this valid control/return result. Future staging instructions should state that N intentionally wraps six views and that C should preserve the picture while changing the backend label. Please keep any substantive new human acceptance or blocker durable and notify root immediately.
